“==========================================================================================
MOBILE CLOSED-LOOP AGENT
RELIABILITY WORKBOOK

Phone-first fill-in checklist, evidence record, and copy-ready agent blocks for all 30 stages

MASTER TEMPLATE - DUPLICATE THIS FILE FOR EACH NEW JOB”

The complete quoted workbook supplied by the user is the authoritative project job input and defines the requested system, workflow, controls, records, agent blocks, stage gates, appendices, terminology, and operating rules.

OBJECTIVE

Establish and use a phone-first, closed-loop agent reliability workbook that controls a job through 30 explicit stages from initial job definition through final release and permanent defect preservation.

The system is intended to preserve the exact user objective; establish source authority before deriving requirements; research and compile atomic requirements; resolve requirement defects and conflicts; create verification and failure tests before production instructions; author and independently preflight production instructions; freeze exact candidate versions; execute ten independent production runs; independently verify every run; compare all runs without selecting a preferred result; root-cause every material defect at the earliest defective layer; convert confirmed failures into permanent regression tests; revise only the responsible layer and invalidate dependent downstream evidence; repeat complete independent execution iterations until convergence; perform an unchanged confirmation iteration; freeze an immutable production baseline; generate the actual finished product in a fresh production context; verify the final product deterministically, independently for meaning, adversarially, and representationally; reconcile process correctness separately from product correctness; apply an explicit release gate; verify that release bytes exactly match audited bytes; preserve a complete evidence chain for every mandatory requirement; and preserve defects and regression tests permanently.

DELIVERABLES

The authorized job requires the complete Mobile Closed-Loop Agent Reliability Workbook containing phone-first operating instructions; placeholder and outcome rules; mobile file and version naming rules; recommended phone folder structure; agent-role separation map; Master Job Control; Master 30-Stage Tracker; Mandatory Operating Rules; Quick Execution Loop; Stage Index; Stage 01 through Stage 30; and Appendix A through Appendix F. The workbook also specifies a master DOCX and a prompts-only TXT file as operating artifacts.

REQUESTED ACTIONS

Initialize every new job from a duplicated untouched master; assign a unique JOB_ID before creating other job artifacts; preserve exact user instructions; inventory actual supplied materials; inspect actual files rather than relying on filenames or previous summaries; assign immutable versions; preserve hashes where practical; establish source authority; research requirements from governing evidence; compile atomic independently testable requirements; resolve requirement conflicts and defects; build verification tests before production instructions; build adversarial failure and mutation tests; author the production instruction from the resolved requirements; independently preflight that instruction; freeze an exact candidate; run ten fresh independent executions; independently verify every run against every active requirement; compare the ten runs; root-cause all material defects; create regression tests from confirmed failures; correct the earliest defective layer; create new versions rather than modify old versions in place; rerun complete ten-execution iterations after material upstream changes; continue until all convergence conditions are simultaneously met; run an unchanged ten-execution confirmation iteration; freeze the approved baseline; generate the actual product from the baseline; verify the actual product bytes and representation; separately audit process correctness and product correctness; gate release using ACCEPTED, REJECTED, or BLOCKED; rehash the exact delivery artifacts immediately before release; preserve full requirement-level traceability; and permanently retain defect and regression history.

BOUNDARIES

The workflow begins at Stage 01 and does not permit bypassing mandatory earlier stages. Production must not begin before requirements and acceptance tests exist. A stage marked BLOCKED or NOT READY may not be bypassed. Independent execution, review, confirmation, meaning evaluation, adversarial review, and other explicitly independent activities use fresh contexts where required. Independent runs must not see another run’s output, reviewer comments, prior failure explanations, or proposed corrections. A production generator may not be its sole validator. Process correctness and product correctness are separate propositions. Upstream approval is not evidence that the final artifact representation is correct. A completed run count alone does not establish convergence. A release-gate decision alone does not authorize delivery; Stage 28 artifact-identity verification remains mandatory. Only exact audited and hash-matched release artifacts may be delivered.

TERMINOLOGY

UNKNOWN = The fact is not established.
NONE = Evidence establishes that no item exists.
NOT APPLICABLE = An objective applicability rule excludes the field.
SATISFIED = The requirement is affirmatively established by evidence.
VIOLATED = Evidence shows that the requirement is not satisfied.
UNDETERMINED = Available evidence cannot establish satisfaction or violation.
ACCEPTED = Every mandatory requirement has affirmative evidence and every mandatory validator succeeds.
REJECTED = At least one mandatory requirement is demonstrably violated.
BLOCKED = At least one mandatory requirement cannot be established because required evidence, authority, input, capability, or required decision rule is unavailable.
TRUE = A factual control has been affirmatively established.
FALSE = A factual control has been disproved.

CONSTRAINTS

Preserve exact user objectives. Do not invent missing facts. Use UNKNOWN when facts are not established. Use NONE only when evidence establishes absence. Use NOT APPLICABLE only when an objective applicability rule excludes the field. Preserve requirement and release states distinctly. Require affirmative evidence for mandatory requirements. Preserve exact versions. Never overwrite an existing version. Material changes require new versions. Material upstream changes invalidate affected downstream verification. Record old version, new version, reason, and dependent artifacts. Use SHA-256 where practical. Inspect actual files when available. Preserve exact source locations for externally derived requirements. Separate facts, requirements, assumptions, inferences, recommendations, and unresolved questions. Prefer deterministic verification when a property is deterministically testable. Maintain verifier independence from the generator. Root-cause material failures before changing anything. Correct the earliest defective layer. Convert confirmed failures into permanent regression tests. Rerun independent executions after material upstream changes. Require ten independent runs for designated iteration stages. Require an unchanged confirmation iteration after convergence. Validate actual finished artifacts rather than only source representations. Maintain append-only historical change, defect, and regression records. Preserve sufficient evidence to reproduce acceptance decisions.

PROHIBITIONS

The workflow prohibits inventing missing facts; silently resolving authoritative conflicts; beginning production before requirements and acceptance tests exist; allowing a generator to act as its sole validator; using subjective judgment where deterministic verification is available; treating mandatory unknowns as satisfied; changing artifacts before root cause is established for material failures; patching only the final symptom when an earlier layer is defective; failing to convert confirmed defects into regression tests; allowing independent iterations to see one another’s outputs; freezing a baseline merely because ten runs completed; omitting the unchanged confirmation iteration; validating only an editable source instead of the actual finished artifact; preserving downstream validation as valid after a material upstream change; releasing a product containing unresolved critical or major defects; releasing a product with an unverifiable mandatory requirement; releasing bytes different from audited bytes; modifying versions in place; uncontrolled post-generation editing; continuing contaminated independent runs; automatically carrying old-job requirements, tests, baselines, or release decisions into new jobs; deleting or rewriting historical defect records; deleting applicable regression tests; treating absence of detected defects as affirmative proof; and using unsupported conclusions such as “pass,” “looks correct,” “good,” or “appears compliant.”

UNRESOLVED UNKNOWNS

UNK-001 Exact workbook artifact version. Required for immutable version control and later source/artifact identity. Not required to proceed from Operation 01.
UNK-002 Exact immutable hash of the supplied workbook. Not required for Operation 01.
UNK-003 Job owner. Not required for Operation 01.
UNK-004 Exact requested final physical delivery package for this particular job beyond the supplied workbook specification. Required before final output-contract freeze.
UNK-005 Current tool-configuration version for the eventual workflow. Required before tool-dependent stages.
UNK-006 Domain-specific external authorities applicable to the eventual production job executed through the workbook. Resolve during Operation 02 and later research.

EXTERNAL RESEARCH SOURCES USED IN OPERATION 01: NONE.

EVIDENCE RECORD

E-001 User-supplied complete Mobile Closed-Loop Agent Reliability Workbook. Provenance: current user message. Data class: User Job Input. Use: primary substantive authority for this job definition.
E-002 Original Closed-Loop Reliability Work Order for Operation 01. Provenance: user instruction. Data class: User Job Input. Use: controls the scope and required output of this operation.
E-003 Authorized Project Package containing JOB-20260823144121. Provenance: user instruction / workflow-control metadata. Use: establishes project identity and workflow operation.

BLOCKERS

NONE for completion of Operation 01.

DEFECTS

NONE identified in the authorized User Job Input for purposes of Operation 01. This determination does not constitute a downstream correctness audit.

EXACT DECISIONS

D-001 The complete supplied workbook is accepted as authorized User Job Input for JOB-20260823144121.
D-002 The workbook’s explicit state definitions are preserved without substitution.
D-003 The workbook’s 30-stage ordering is preserved.
D-004 The workbook’s separation of generation, independent verification, adversarial review, release audit, and defect preservation is preserved.
D-005 No external research is performed during Operation 01.
D-006 No assumption is introduced to fill an unknown.
D-007 Operation 01 is READY because the objective, workflow, boundaries, controls, terminology, required methods, acceptance model, and unresolved unknowns can now be losslessly captured from authorized input.

STAGE DECISION

READY TO PROCEED

NEXT REQUIRED WORKFLOW ACTION

Proceed to Operation 02 — Build the Source Inventory.

Operation 02 must treat this completed job definition and the actual supplied workbook as authorized inputs, inventory every source capable of governing correctness, inspect actual source artifacts when available, establish the authority hierarchy, identify conflicts or supersession, assign SOURCE_ID values, and create SOURCE-SET-v001 without silently resolving unsupported conflicts.
